title: Graph extension from a compactification
statement:
Let $S$ be qcqs, $M\to S$ separated of finite type, and $V\subseteq M$ a
quasi-compact open with a compactification $V\subseteq Y$ over $S$. After a
$V$-admissible blow-up of $Y$ ([sk-def-nagata-admissible]) there is an open
$V\subseteq V'\subseteq Y$ and a proper map $\psi:V'\to M$ with
$\psi^{-1}(V)=V$ and $\psi|_V=\mathrm{id}_V$.

proof.text:
Form the schematic closure $G$ of the graph of $V\to M$ in $Y\times_SM$
([sk-lem-nagata-sketch-closure]). Its projection to $Y$ is separated of
finite type and is an isomorphism over $V$. By
[sk-lem-nagata-sketch-elimination] its strict transform is an open
$V'\subseteq Y'$ after an admissible blow-up. Formation of the graph closure
under this modification gives that strict transform: both are the closure of
the same graph outside the exceptional divisor (Stacks 0F3Y;
[sk-lem-nagata-sketch-image-transform]). On the other hand $G'$ is closed in
$Y'\times_SM$, whose projection to $M$ is proper. Thus $V'\simeq G'\to M$ is
proper. Its inverse image of $V$ is the closed graph over $V$, namely $V$
itself. This proves the lemma; it is also Stacks 0F3Z.

lean.statement:
theorem Compactification.nonempty_properExtension
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] (u : U ⟶ S)
    [IsSeparated u] [LocallyOfFiniteType u] [QuasiCompact u]
    (V : U.Opens) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set U)) (c : Compactification (V.ι ≫ u)) :
    Nonempty (Compactification.ProperExtension u V c)
lean.note: The source declaration is the exact graph-extension existence theorem for the node (Stacks Tag 0F3Z). Its typeclass assumptions encode qcqs S ([CompactSpace S] and [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]), separated finite-type u ([IsSeparated u], [LocallyOfFiniteType u], [QuasiCompact u]), and hV gives the quasi-compact open V. The compactification c is the given V-to-S compactification. Its conclusion Nonempty (Compactification.ProperExtension u V c) packages the V-admissible blow-up, open V^gr, proper ψ, identity over V, exact inverse image, and restriction isomorphism required by the node. The ProperExtension structure uses AlgebraicGeometry.IsAdmissible for the admissible blow-up notion recorded by sk-def-nagata-admissible.
